extraction_notes: Supporting Information tables S3-S5 are referenced but not provided in the input; only main-text/page-image values were extracted. Figure 2d is a literature comparison and was not extracted. Figure 5d reports normalized STY rather than absolute methanol STY and was not extracted as catalyst-performance records. Arrhenius/reaction-order plots were not extracted because they report kinetic fits/log rates rather than directly tabulated conversion/selectivity/STY performance points.
